title: McDonald's X-Men Portrait
description: A man dressed in a grey and black X-Men style armored uniform with a prominent yellow McDonald's 'M' logo on the chest stands holding a red McDonald's drink cup in one hand and a glowing staff in the other. In the foreground sits a Big Mac, chicken nuggets, french fries, and McDonald's packaging on a dark surface, set against a large stylized purple and white flower mural with red neon lighting.
prompt: A cinematic scene featuring a man in dark grey X-Men inspired armor with a yellow McDonald's logo on the chest, holding a red McDonald's soda cup and a glowing staff. He stands beside a table displaying a Big Mac, chicken nuggets, french fries in a red carton, and McDonald's packaging. Behind him is a massive stylized purple and white flower mural with golden details and red neon light accents in a dark modern interior.
